chunks: God counsels you not to do a thing like this, if you are believers.

key_terms.لِمِثْلِهِ: to its like / to the core of the matter

ai.seo_question: What does God command believers not to do if they are true in their faith?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is viewed as a comprehensive moral injunction following the incident of Al-Ifk, urging believers to internalize the lesson rather than merely observing it. It highlights that true faith (Iman) necessitates consistency in character, preventing a return to the 'core' of the slander—whether in speech, thought, or action—once the truth has been revealed. This serves as a perpetual reminder for the community to maintain purity of heart and tongue in the wake of major trials.
